press_references.value: OpenX Launches OpenX IQ, a Suite of AI and Machine Learning Capabilities to Power Customized Media Decisioning

product_launches.description: OpenX launched OpenX IQ, a new suite of AI and machine-learning–based intelligence features that adds an intelligence layer to its SSP, giving advertisers, agencies, and publishers more transparent, customizable media buying decisioning across the workflow.

press_references.value: OpenX Repositions as The Intelligent SSP™ to Simplify Advertising

product_launches.description: OpenX introduced a streamlined product suite—OpenXSelect, OpenXBuild, OpenXControl, and OpenXExchange—as part of its repositioning as The Intelligent SSP to simplify digital advertising.

press_references.value: OpenX Powers Political Reach With Preferred Access to Quality, Direct Media for the 2026 Midterm Election Season

product_launches.description: OpenX introduced a new political advertising solution for the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, offering prioritized access to curated, politically-approved inventory, ZIP-code-level targeting, turnkey political packages, and localized measurement across CTV, mobile, and web.

press_references.value: OpenX Unveils OpenXBuild: A New Software Suite for Building Better Advertising Solutions

product_launches.description: OpenX launched OpenXBuild, a new software suite and set of APIs that lets advertisers apply their own data and decisioning models in real time to improve ad performance and efficiency.

press_references.value: OpenX Becomes First Platform to Offer Agencies Automated Discounts From Curation and Data Partners

product_launches.description: OpenX launched an automated partner-discount capability in OpenXSelect, enabling agencies to activate negotiated discounts from 80+ curation and tech partners like Audigent, Captify, and Rippl to preserve working media and improve outcomes.

press_references.value: OpenX Announces OpenXSelect, an Advanced Supply-Side Targeting and Curation Platform for Brands and Agencies

product_launches.description: OpenX Technologies announced the general availability of OpenXSelect, a next-generation curation and supply-side targeting platform for brands and agencies, offering advanced inventory control, audience targeting, and optimization features.

overview_description.description: OpenX is a supply-side platform for audience, data, and identity targeting, boosting reach and revenue with top tech and services. The company’s leading technology aggregates, curates, and values consumer interest in real time on one of the world’s largest and highest quality ad exchanges to ensure marketers reach exactly the audience they want. OpenX serves more than 30,000 of the world’s most recognized brands, more than 1,200 websites, and more than 2,000 premium mobile apps.

about_short_description.short_description: OpenX is a supply-side platform for audience, data, and identity targeting, boosting reach and revenue with top tech and service.

product.name: OpenXSelect
product.description: A platform for supply-side targeting, advertising inventory curation, and programmatic deal creation. It helps advertisers access selected audiences and publisher inventory through direct, data-driven packages.

product.name: OpenXExchange
product.description: A real-time advertising marketplace that connects automated buyers with quality digital advertising inventory from publishers across programmatic channels and formats.

product.name: OpenXControl
product.description: A yield and monetization platform for publishers that manages advertising inventory and connects it with demand partners to support revenue optimization and operational control.

product.name: OpenXBuild
product.description: A cloud-based software suite for building custom advertising, audience, bidding, identity, and measurement solutions that operate close to programmatic supply.
